items.title: 15.9 Diagnostic tests for nervous disorders (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to diagnostic tests (PDF 51-52).

blocks.text: Nervous system ki bimariyon ki tashkhees ke liye kai test banaye gaye hain. Teen aham test electroencephalography (EEG), computed tomography (CT) aur magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) hain.

blocks.prompt: Teeno mein se kaunsa test tasveer banane ke bajaye barqi sargarmi record karta hai?

items: Tashkhees ke test: EEG, CT, MRI.
